name: Hayarigami Kakushi ~Gakuen Kaii Jiken File~
original_name: 流行り神隠し ～学園怪異事件ファイル～
source:
This is a parody mystery visual novel game that blends Azumanga Daiou with a certain mystery game. 

Female students begin disappearing one after another at the academy where the protagonist is called. Is it really a case of being spirited away? 

[Translated from [url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_009393/]DMM[/url]]
